identity.description: FanBasis, now rebranded as Commas, is a platform to create, sell and get paid online (checkouts, funnels, courses, communities, webinars, affiliates) with built-in payments, BNPL, and enterprise APIs/SDKs.
identity.identity_notes: Sources state 'FanBasis is now Commas!' on commas.com. No public API docs in sources.

api.limitations: Sources only mention APIs and SDKs for enterprise marketing; no endpoint docs, resources or auth details.

claims.quote: MCP beta Run Commas from your AI assistant. Create checkout links, issue refunds and pull your numbers in plain English.
Embedded checkouts, multi-rail payouts, APIs and SDKs. Everything you'd replace Stripe with, plus BNPL, recovery and lower effective rates.

open_questions: Auth methods are not documented in the sources.
Access tier for API credentials is unknown (enterprise page suggests sales-led, but not explicit).
API protocols, resources and breadth are not documented; no developer docs found.
Is the MCP server hosted/documented anywhere? No URL provided.

assessment.approach: Wrap/benchmark vendor's official MCP server; add managed auth
